critical_journeys.claim: A user can inspect the month, record/review spending, and obtain the resulting budget/safe-to-spend state coherently.
residual_gaps: physical Android WebView, OEM lifecycle and accessibility behavior

critical_journeys.claim: A user can export/import the supported portable financial-data surface without silently changing canonical ledger semantics.
residual_gaps: physical Android file-picker/storage-provider integration when that surface changes

critical_journeys.claim: An Android payment candidate remains outside the canonical ledger until the user reviews and explicitly confirms or ignores it.
residual_gaps: OEM process lifecycle and reboot recovery

critical_journeys.claim: The built Android debug/release-candidate artifact installs, launches, renders the shared application and recovers across the supported native lifecycle.
